question: After genuinely fixing src/spider/kernel.py distill_parameterized (single-prefix _common_prefix_and_suffix, field-path relevance filter url/body.*/headers.* only, Jaccard >=0.75 constant-anchor check, distinct slot per field-path, confidence 0.90) verified by code inspection/unit tests, does a narrowed family hold-out single-family pilot on WebArena-Verified v2 (train 3-5 exemplars of one family on resource A, test zero-overlap resource B, >=1 family >=10 tasks) achieve EXECUTABLE >=0.75 and binding correctness >=0.90 with zero unsubstituted templates, success margin >=0.12 vs each of B-COLD/B-RAG/B-REPLAY-TERX/B-INSTR, false_accept <=0.10 UNKNOWN in [0.00,0.15] ECE <=0.15, with family-stratified bootstrap CIs, deterministic _matches verification, and honest tokens+browser+retrieval+verification cost?
hypothesis: A corrected kernel-integrated distill_parameterized() fixing three previously falsified bugs — (1) _common_prefix_and_suffix uses single-prefix (common prefix only) so full resource-B identifiers bind without double-prefix truncation (e.g., 'user-4' not truncated to '4'), (2) field-path relevance filter restricts _extract_varying_values to action-template-relevant paths only (url/path, body.*, headers.*) excluding top-level provenance/state/metadata noise, (3) structure-similarity Jaccard >=0.75 constant-value anchor check rejects pattern-absence hallucination (E1) — with distinct slot naming per field-path (body.sku -> ${sku}, headers.X-Csrf-Token -> ${csrf_token}, url path segment -> ${resource_id}) at confidence 0.90 ported to src/spider/kernel.py and verified by code inspection + unit tests (regression B1/B4 still pass, D1 noisy over-param and E1 hallucination correctly rejected, B2/B3/B5 short-value cases), will enable a real-LLM agent (gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 or approved haiku/flash equivalent, temp 0.0, seed 42, max 15 steps, 4096 tokens, identical Playwright toolset navigate/click/fill/type/select/goBack/observe on chromium headless) learning 3-5 exemplars of a single family on resource A to resolve EXECUTABLE with correct bound_action on never-observed resource B (zero exact value overlap for parameterized slots, family hold-out not random split) and achieve end-to-end (H1) EXECUTABLE >=0.75 and binding correctness >=0.90 with zero unsubstituted ${} templates, (H2) task success >=0.12 absolute above each baseline B-COLD, B-RAG, B-REPLAY-TERX, B-INSTR on the same held-out B set, (H3) false_accept <=0.10, UNKNOWN rate in [0.00,0.15] with ECE <=0.15, (H4) honest cost per task measured as LLM tokens (API usage) + browser calls+ms + retrieval 200 tok + verification 50 tok + repair 1 step, amortized distill ~1000 tok only to SPIDER at f=10, reported with family/task bootstrap CIs — demonstrating parameterized inheritance exists beyond narrow synthetic ceilings (EXP-PRODUCT-33528829801 10/10 single-param, EXP-PRODUCT-33741671686 harness-only 21/21 multi-param not kernel) in the smallest valid real-LLM pilot that is measurement-ready without distributed Redis session store.
falsifier: FALSIFIED if ANY primary gate fails on held-out B via real LLM+Playwright deterministic verification (not proxy): (F1) M-EXECUTABLE-SPIDER <0.75 (Wilson lower <0.65) or M-BINDING-CORRECT <0.90 (Wilson lower <0.80) or M-UNSUBSTITUTED-TEMPLATES >0 among EXECUTABLE (double-prefix or slot collision not fixed); (F2) M-SUCCESS-SPIDER - max(B-COLD,B-RAG,B-REPLAY-TERX,B-INSTR) <0.12 (task-stratified bootstrap 95% CI lower <=0.02 or McNemar p>=0.05), i.e., no margin over strongest memory/instruction baseline on single-family B; (F3) M-FALSE-ACCEPT-SPIDER >0.10 or M-UNKNOWN-RATE outside [0.00,0.15] or ECE >0.15 (calibration/abstention miscalibrated); (F4) null-control check fails to show parameterization necessity: NC1 shuffled success >= SPIDER -0.05 or NC1 binding >=0.50 with false_accept <0.25 meaning reuse without correct slots matches SPIDER. MIXED if F1 passes but F2 fails (binds correctly but agent fails downstream verification/repair within 1 repair step). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if: kernel fix not ported to src/spider/kernel.py or not exercised via real registry required_slots|template_slots + _bind (hash audit fails), <10 valid tasks after dedup/zero-overlap filtering on single family, WebArena-Verified v2 census not loaded (192 tasks/49 templates/dup 0.9479/param_task 0.8958 families>=3 36/AX 0.9 not verified), Playwright verification broken, LLM API unavailable >50% trials, or family hold-out leakage (B values overlapping A, value_set intersection !=0). Prior synthetic mock 72-task duplication-hardcoded ceiling does not count. Cost at f=10 is secondary: if cost saving <25% vs COLD or ratio >0.85 vs RAG, claim does not advance on economics but may still SURVIVE on inheritance if C1-C3 pass; economics then reported as not demonstrated.

baselines.description: Cold LLM agent with no SPIDER memory: same model/tools/budget (15 steps, Playwright chromium headless, same prompt without retrieved mechanisms). Cost = measured LLM input+output tokens (API usage) + browser calls (count+ms) + latency per task. Upper-bound full-re-exploration cost; no retrieval, no verification shortcut, no distill. Tests whether SPIDER adds value beyond base agent on novel B identifiers of the single pilot family.
baselines.expected: Success lower than SPIDER on held-out B (same family, unseen identifiers); cost flat vs novelty; denominator for amortized saving. SPIDER expected +0.12 success and honest amortized accounting.

baselines.description: Semantic retrieval / RAG over prior trajectories: same LLM retrieves nearest successful trajectory from training pool A by Jaccard over intent+state keywords (threshold 0.30) and replays verbatim without parameter induction. Retrieval cost 200 tok + measured ms. If retrieved identifiers match test B at deterministic postcondition verification (_matches), reuse at 0 LLM tokens for matching prefix; otherwise fallback to COLD LLM exploration for mismatched steps. Hit/miss measured directly; single-family hold-out ensures many mismatches on B (parameter values differ). Same verification.
baselines.expected: Hit_rate ~0.0-0.10 on held-out B (family hold-out guarantees identifier mismatch; duplication 0.9479 is parameterized reuse, exact-copy 0.0781). Success << SPIDER without parameterization. SPIDER expected success >= RAG+0.12 and cost <=0.85x RAG amortized at f=10 if economics gate evaluated.

baselines.description: 0-token exact replay (TERX/BrowserBash) with LLM fallback: if test task's full parameterized identifier sequence exactly equals a training trajectory A (exact string equality on action_template including path+body+headers, no parameterization), replay at 0 LLM tokens +1 verification browser call (50 tok, 90ms) +1 browser execution; otherwise replay fails deterministic verification and falls back to COLD LLM exploration for full task. Strongest exact-repeat baseline. Hit cost = 50 tok verification only; miss cost = COLD cost. Hit_rate measured inside compared set (expected ~0.0 on family hold-out B, ~1.0 on same-resource control).
baselines.expected: Hit_rate ~0.0 on held-out B (by design B never observed) -> cost = COLD. SPIDER expected cheaper than REPLAY on held-out where REPLAY misses and within 2x of REPLAY on same-resource control where REPLAY hits at 50 tok.

baselines.description: Site-specific hand-authored instructions baseline: same LLM supplied with natural-language site instructions (e.g., WebArena shopping procedure for the pilot family) but no parameterized mechanism or retrieval. Instruction tokens 200 amortized over f=10 (20 tok/task). Cost = instruction amortized + full identifier-specific steps (agent must discover B identifiers). Tests whether instructions alone achieve transfer without SPIDER param slots.
baselines.expected: Cost slightly below COLD but above SPIDER; success below SPIDER on multi-param B identifiers. SPIDER expected to beat INSTR by >=0.10 success.

baselines.description: Literal (zero-parameter) mechanism replay: distill literal mechanisms via current kernel distill() without parameter induction and attempt resolve on B via exact registry match. Tests that parameterization is necessary (literal should fail on unseen B). Same verification; measures false_accept if literal incorrectly resolves.
baselines.expected: Success ~0.0 on held-out B, EXECUTABLE 0.0, confirming literal cannot handle novelty. If B-LITERAL success >0.15 on single-family B, family hold-out leakage suspected -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

positive_control.description: Two positive controls exercising real pipeline on same substrate: (PC1) Same-resource literal hit: training resource A mechanism replayed on same resource A with identical identifiers must achieve hit_rate 1.0 via B-REPLAY-TERX pipeline with 0 LLM tokens +1 browser verification call (50 tok) and success 1.0; validates substrate can measure 0-cost case and Playwright deterministic verification works. (PC2) Multi-param regression on same A: harness-induced mechanism from 3-5 A observations of the pilot family with path+body+headers varying (same distill_parameterized as SPIDER) tested on same A via actual registry required_slots|template_slots/_bind/verify must resolve EXECUTABLE 1.0, binding correctness 1.0, success >=0.90, zero templates. Confirms induction works before testing generalization to B. Both use measured verification outcomes, not forced constants. Failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification.
positive_control.expected_behavior: PC1: B-REPLAY same-A cost 50 tok, 1 browser call, success 1.0, hit_rate 1.0. PC2: multi-param same-A EXECUTABLE 1.0, binding 1.0, success >=0.90, zero templates. Thresholds frozen; n=5-10 per PC sufficient for pilot.

null_control.description: Two null controls via real bind/verify semantics on same held-out B set: (NC1) Shuffled slot mapping: randomly permute learned parameter_slots -> identifier binding (e.g., swap ${sku} with ${store_id}) before SPIDER resolve via actual registry/_bind/verify; each task incurs real retrieval+verify+fallback costs based on verification outcomes (mismatched binds fail verification and trigger repair/fallback cost). Expected success <= B-COLD, false_accept >=0.25, binding correctness <0.50, proving transfer requires correct parameterization not any reuse. (NC2) Random retrieval: SPIDER retrieval returns random registry entry instead of ranked match, UNKNOWN disabled, via actual ranking path; expected false_accept >=0.30 or success <= B-COLD, demonstrating ranking/gating matters. Both go through actual binding/verification so they CAN fail the expected null pattern if mapping truly matters.
null_control.expected_behavior: NC1 shuffled success <= B-COLD +0.05 and false_accept >=0.25 and binding correctness <0.50. NC2 random false_accept >=0.30 or success <= B-COLD. If NC1 success >= SPIDER -0.05, SPIDER effect is spurious (task difficulty confounded) -> measurement invalid for param-inherit claim.

measurement_validity: 1. Real LLM execution (not token proxy): same approved model (gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 or equivalent approved haiku/flash, temp 0.0, seed 42 where supported) with identical Playwright toolset (navigate, click, fill, type, select, goBack, observe DOM) and identical budget (max 15 steps, max 4096 output tokens, 30s per step timeout) across SPIDER/COLD/RAG/REPLAY/INSTR/LITERAL and NCs. Each task cost = measured LLM input+output tokens via API usage (not formula), browser calls (count + wall ms), retrieval tokens/latency (200 tok+measured ms if SPIDER/RAG), verification tokens/latency (50 tok+measured ms if EXECUTABLE attempted), repair tokens/calls if verification fails (1 LLM step). Distill cost ~1000 tok amortized over f=10 added ONLY to SPIDER for amortized comparison. No bijective cost=250+500*10*novelty proxy; per AGENTS.md failure discipline bijective mock is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

2. Narrowed single-family family hold-out with zero B overlap on WebArena-Verified v2 census: load from repo cache, /tmp/webarena, or verified CSV (192 shopping tasks, 49 intent_templates, duplication 0.9479 95% CI [0.9167,0.9792], exact-copy 0.0781 [0.0417,0.1198], param_task 0.8958, 36 families >=3 [34 >=4,33 >=5] per EXP-INTEL-35749371101 audit PASS). For this pilot, select >=1 family with >=10 tasks after dedup by template+intent hash; require >=2 resource pools A/B with disjoint identifiers (SKU, store, user, issue IDs) within that family. Training uses 3-5 exemplars from A only; test B values have zero exact value overlap with A for parameterized slots (verified by value set intersection =0, logged). Family hold-out (not random split) prevents site identity leakage. Minimum 10 valid tasks required for decision; target 12-20 if LLM budget allows. Source, duplication handling, family split and zero-overlap proof logged in provenance.json with hashes; claim ceiling bounded to pilot family only, not 10-family generalization; fallback synthetic mock requires explicit ceiling downgrade and then MEASUREMENT_INVALID for WebArena claim.

3. Corrected kernel-integrated distill_parameterized: fix (a) _common_prefix_and_suffix single-prefix so full B identifiers bind correctly, (b) field-path relevance filter restricting _extract_varying_values to action-template-relevant paths only (url/path, body.*, headers.*) excluding top-level metadata/provenance/state noise, (c) structure-similarity Jaccard >=0.75 constant-value anchor check to reject pattern-absence hallucination. Distinct slot naming per field-path (body.sku -> ${sku}, headers.X-Csrf-Token -> ${csrf_token}, path segment -> ${resource_id}) with confidence 0.90 via actual registry write/read. At resolve, required_slots = set(parameter_slots) | _template_slots(action_template); freshness gating behavioral_score 0.25 and confidence gating <0.80 -> UNKNOWN abstention; if UNKNOWN -> fallback to COLD LLM cost; if EXECUTABLE -> bound_action = _bind(action_template, params) via actual _bind and Playwright execution + deterministic postcondition verification (_matches on observed DOM/state after execution, not LLM-as-judge); on verification failure charge repair cost and count false_accept if binding wrong. Code path must be src/spider/kernel.py (graph allowed to patch src per Director REOPEN) verified by audit diff and src sha256, not only research harness copy. Unit tests must cover double-prefix full-value (user-4), short values (B2/B3/B5), noisy over-param D1, hallucination E1.

4. Strong baseline execution on identical held-out B set with identical LLM/tools/budget and same deterministic verification logic. B-RAG Jaccard TAU=0.30 and success follows verification. B-REPLAY exact action_template string equality to decide hit/miss. B-INSTR instruction tokens correctly amortized as 200/f. B-LITERAL uses literal kernel distill without slots. No baseline handicapped; all costs measured in same units (tokens, ms, calls). BrowserGym 1280x720 AX optional per Director dependencies but not blocking; Playwright alone suffices for this pilot.

5. Honest end-to-end cost accounting: per-task cost measured as above; amortized cost per success = (total_tokens + distill_tokens/f)/success_rate where distill_tokens ~1000 added only to SPIDER and instruction_tokens 200 amortized as 200/f for INSTR only. Report both raw per-task and amortized (f=1,10,100) with task-stratified bootstrap (or family-block bootstrap collapses to task bootstrap for single family) 5000 resamples seed 42 for CI on cost ratios and success differences, plus deterministic verification. Latency includes LLM + browser + retrieval + verification + repair. Token, browser, latency reported separately and combined. Contamination <0.10 measured as registry cross-family leakage via unrelated mechanisms; B-LITERAL and NC1/NC2 false_accept operationalize random-patch false_accept.

6. Verification and calibration: verification is deterministic postcondition _matches on observed DOM/state after Playwright execution (not LLM-as-judge). Verification AUROC, false_accept/false_reject, UNKNOWN precision >=0.85 contamination <0.10 measured where applicable; report verification success vs true task success correlation. UNKNOWN abstention measured per family; report ECE (expected calibration error) for confidence vs success with 10 bins, threshold 0.15. For single-family pilot, ECE computed on task-level bins (at least 10 tasks, may be sparse; disclose bin counts). Freshness guard behavioral_score exercised where available; if distributed session store unavailable, disclosure not blocking per Director dependencies (centralized-session-store not required for single-family pilot).

7. Statistics honoring task structure: primary success comparison SPIDER vs each baseline uses paired McNemar or task bootstrap (5000 resamples, seed 42) for single-family pilot; for multi-family extension would be family-stratified block bootstrap. Two-sided 95% CI; Wilson 95% CI for EXECUTABLE and binding correctness. Report both. Power: at n>=10 pilot, minimal detectable delta vs baseline is larger; disclose power: with baseline 0.45 and n=10, power to detect 0.12 delta is low (~0.25), so pilot is existence proof not powered for precise margin; CI lower >0.02 and McNemar p<0.05 still required but wide CIs expected; report Wilson lower bounds explicitly. No degenerate Spearman; null controls via permutation. Trajectories not treated as independent beyond task.

8. Prereg frozen before any outcome-bearing measurement; code (src/spider/kernel.py patch), fixtures, model version, thresholds hashed in freeze.json. Deterministic seeds (PYTHONHASHSEED=0, random.seed 42, LLM seed 42), all hashes logged. Raw evidence preserved: per-task CSV with tokens, calls, latency, success, bound_action, verification, UNKNOWN, false_accept, ECE bins; registry JSON with slots/templates; cost_config JSON; Playwright traces sampled; provenance.json with commits, run ids, dataset hashes, WebArena census verification, kernel sha256 and code inspection log.
decision_rule: SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires ALL of (C1)-(C5) measured via actual real-LLM+Playwright deterministic verification on single-family pilot (not proxy): (C1) M-SUCCESS-SPIDER >=0.65 and > B-COLD by >=0.12 absolute and > B-RAG by >=0.12 and > B-REPLAY-TERX by >=0.12 and > B-INSTR by >=0.10, with task bootstrap (5000, seed 42) 95% CI lower >0.02 for each margin and McNemar two-sided p<0.05 where n permits; (C2) mechanism quality M-EXECUTABLE-SPIDER >=0.75 (Wilson lower >=0.65) and M-BINDING-CORRECT >=0.90 (Wilson lower >=0.80) among EXECUTABLE with M-UNSUBSTITUTED-TEMPLATES =0; (C3) safety S-SAFETY: M-FALSE-ACCEPT-SPIDER <=0.10 and M-UNKNOWN-RATE-SPIDER in [0.00,0.15] on valid B and B-LITERAL success <=0.15 on same B (confirms param necessity); (C4) controls: PC1 same-A replay hit_rate 1.0 cost 50 tok success 1.0 PASS and PC2 multi-param same-A EXECUTABLE 1.0 binding 1.0 success >=0.90 PASS; NC1 shuffled success <= B-COLD +0.05 and false_accept >=0.25 and NC2 random false_accept >=0.30 or success <= B-COLD (NCs through real bind/verify); (C5) calibration: UNKNOWN cases have confidence <0.80 or required_slots missing, ECE <=0.15 with 10 bins, verification AUROC >=0.75 where measurable, contamination <0.10. Secondary (C6) economics E-ECON reported but not gating for SURVIVES in pilot: M-AMORTIZED-SAVING-SPIDER-vs-COLD and M-COST-RATIO-RAG at f=10 with bootstrap CI reported; if saving >=25% and ratio <=0.85 would strengthen product claim but pilot may SURVIVE without it due to limited n. FALSIFIED if any C1-C3 fails on valid single-family substrate (excluding PC/NC substrate failures which are MEASUREMENT_INVALID). MIXED if C1 margin fails but C2 passes (binds correctly but agent fails downstream verification/repair). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if harness cannot induce distinct slots (collision), registry/resolve not exercising real required_slots/_bind via src/spider/kernel.py, <10 valid tasks after dedup/zero-overlap, census not verified (192/49/36/dup 0.9479/param_task 0.8958), LLM API unavailable >50% trials, or verification broken (substrate failure not scientific falsification per AGENTS.md). All thresholds frozen; primary outcome is C1 success margin plus C2 binding gates; pilot ceiling is single-family only.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES: C-PARAM-INHERIT advances from EXPERIMENTAL (narrow synthetic ceilings: 10/10 single-param 5.42% saving, 21/21 harness-only multi-param not kernel, 42 prior attempts KERNEL-INTEGRATION-FALSIFIED/PARTIAL, last MEASUREMENT_INVALID 0/60 tasks) to VALIDATED at bounded single-family real-LLM pilot ceiling (WebArena-Verified v2 one family path+body+headers, real Playwright deterministic verification, parameterized transfer beyond retrieval/replay). Establishes first direct measurement that a corrected multi-parameter mechanism learned on A generalizes to never-observed B with EXECUTABLE binding and quantified honest cost (success +0.12 vs strongest baseline, false_accept <=0.10, UNKNOWN calibrated ECE <=0.15) in the smallest measurement-ready pilot without distributed infra. Unblocks C-LLM-INHERIT and C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY scale-up to 10-family and Docker full-DOM hosting; informs productization vs TERX 0-token replay dominance (SPIDER wins where replay misses). Authorizes kernel promotion of corrected distill_parameterized with distinct slot naming per field-path to src/spider/kernel.py (promotion_ready true, pending kernel tests). No immediate SHIPPED; requires replication on >=10 families and freshness hardening before SHIPPED.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED: C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL at narrow synthetic ceiling (or bounded REJECTED for single-family real-LLM setting: parameterized transfer does not beat cold/retrieval/replay/instructions on that family's hold-out). If MIXED (binds but no success margin), mechanism binds correctly but downstream agent/verification fails -> product must investigate Playwright execution, verification, or agent prompt, not just induction. If SPIDER not beating B-RAG/B-REPLAY where RAG/REPLAY already miss on hold-out (duplication 0.9479 is 91.8% parameterized reuse, exact-copy 0.0781), multi-parameter inheritance adds no pilot economics beyond retrieval or exact replay; Product should keep pilot finding bounded to single family and redirect next cycle per Director portfolio: prioritize 10-family scale-up only if pilot succeeded, otherwise pivot to higher-leverage gates C-FRESHNESS distributed session/UNKNOWN abstention, C-DELTA-REPAIR localized repair on nginx HIT/SWR/SIE substrate, or C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE calibrated resolution, and defer C-PRODUCT-ECON scale-up. If MEASUREMENT_INVALID due to induction collision, verification broken, <10 tasks, or LLM keys unavailable, priority is fixing kernel src/spider/kernel.py integration (single-prefix, Jaccard >=0.75, field-filter distinct slot naming) and runtime verification substrate before re-testing; pilot result does not falsify hypothesis. Negative still high information: definitively tests kernel fix and single-family existence proof, resolves 42-attempt starved bottleneck and tunnel flags, and prevents premature 10-family spend.
estimated_cost: Single-family pilot: 10-20 tasks (1 family x10-20) x5 conditions (SPIDER/COLD/INSTR/RAG/REPLAY) =50-100 agent runs +10 positive controls +20-40 null controls =80-150 runs. Each run ~8-12 LLM calls x ~1500 tokens avg =12k-18k tokens ~$0.04-$0.08 per run at gpt-4o-mini pricing ($0.15/1M in, $0.60/1M out). Total $3-$12; minimal 10-task pilot $3-$6. Add retrieval/verification negligible. No Docker required; WebArena HTML cached + Playwright localhost chromium headless. Wall-clock ~20-40 min on GitHub Actions (parallel batching 4 concurrent). Storage: per-task CSV ~150 rows, registry JSON, cost_config, traces sampled. Deterministic seeds, all hashes logged. Optional BrowserGym 1280x720 AX not required per Director dependencies; if available adds AX consistency revalidation. Fits within 0.5 GH Action hours.
expected_information_gain: HIGH for a minimal pilot: First valid real-LLM test of SPIDER's central promise after 42 C-PARAM-INHERIT attempts with last MEASUREMENT_INVALID 0/60 tasks (no LLM keys, census not loaded, kernel not ported) and prior ceiling only harness-only 21/21 binding not kernel. Either a positive (single-family EXECUTABLE transfer beating COLD/RAG/REPLAY/INSTR on never-observed B with deterministic _matches and calibrated UNKNOWN/ECE) or a valid negative (no margin vs retrieval/replay on family hold-out where duplication 0.9479 requires genuine parameterization) decisively changes product decision at lowest cost: (1) whether corrected kernel fixes (single-prefix, Jaccard >=0.75, field-path filter distinct slot naming, conf 0.90) justify src/spider/kernel.py promotion and unblock 10-family scale-up vs premature closure, (2) whether C-PARAM-INHERIT advances EXPERIMENTAL->VALIDATED at single-family pilot ceiling and unblocks C-LLM-INHERIT/C-PRODUCT-ECON/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY scale-up, (3) whether parameterized inheritance beats TERX 90ms exact-replay and RAG dominance at low-to-moderate template novelty and informs honest amortized economics without waiting for distributed Redis. Resolves starved-claim bottleneck (0/60 recent Graph valid) and tunnel flags by testing highest-leverage mechanism with strong baselines on measurement-ready substrate (no distributed store needed per Director dependencies). Single-family ceiling is explicitly bounded; 10-family generalization remains unknown and requires follow-on experiment.
